items.title: Reproduce and localize the stale advisory loop
items.context: Use a focused fixture or existing handlers to reproduce validate updating test-evidence.json then session_brief reporting stale while refresh_stale reports no stale.
items.userSees: 用户会在 evidence/reproduction.md 看到："Root cause: validate-generated test-evidence.json self-churn is excluded from material drift, while real material drift remains stale."

happy.desc: A reproduction note or fixture identifies why validate-generated test-evidence can make session_brief report stale after a clean validate/DONE flow.

edge.desc: The reproduction distinguishes self-churn in test-evidence.json from real source/evidence material drift.

adversarial.desc: The reproduction cannot be satisfied by hiding all stale warnings globally; it must preserve a real-drift failing case.

verificationEvidence.note: reproduction.md documents validate-generated test-evidence missing materialHash and custom storyDir metadata gap
reproduction distinguishes test-evidence self-churn from real material drift
regression keeps real material drift stale while allowing metadata-only test-evidence changes

items.title: Define the artifact freshness policy for test-evidence.json
items.context: Document whether test-evidence.json is delivery metadata, material source, or generated test artifact, and how session_brief/DONE gates should treat it.
items.userSees: 用户会在 policy/docs 或代码注释看到："test-evidence.json is gate-consumed validation metadata, not material drift input."

happy.desc: Policy states how test-evidence.json is classified for freshness: generated validation metadata, not material source drift.

edge.desc: Policy states real source/evidence edits still trigger stale warnings and gate checks.

adversarial.desc: Policy does not allow validate output to mask failing validation, missing coverage, delivery-check, or summary gate failures.

verificationEvidence.note: policy states test-evidence.json is gate-consumed validation metadata, not material drift input
policy preserves stale behavior for real source or evidence drift
process fact contract still treats test-evidence.json as gate artifact and does not make validation output mask other gates

items.title: Implement minimal fix in validate/session freshness handling
items.context: Adjust the code so validate-generated test evidence no longer creates an endless stale advisory after commit, without weakening DONE gate freshness for material source changes.
items.userSees: 用户运行 session_brief 时看到："DONE pre-check PASS"，且不会仅因 test-evidence.json 自更新看到 "EVIDENCE STALE"。

happy.desc: Session/freshness logic ignores validate-generated test-evidence self-churn for materialHash stale advisory purposes.

edge.desc: A real material source/evidence file change still produces a stale warning.

adversarial.desc: Failing validate results, missing coverage, delivery-check, or summary are still visible to gates and session_brief.

verificationEvidence.note: freshness logic excludes validate-generated test-evidence self-churn from materialHash stale checks
real material source drift remains stale, including workflow/notes.md outside configured storyDir
failing validate, missing coverage, delivery and summary gates remain governed by process fact contract and gate artifacts

items.title: Add regression coverage
items.context: Add automated coverage for the stale-loop scenario and for a real material drift scenario so the fix is not a broad suppression.
items.userSees: 测试输出会包含："self-churn test-evidence metadata does not stale verification evidence" 和 "real material drift still stale"。

happy.desc: A regression test covers validate/test-evidence self-churn without session_brief stale advisory.

edge.desc: The same regression suite covers committed validate metadata plus a clean working tree.

adversarial.desc: A separate adversarial assertion proves unrelated material drift is still detected as stale.

verificationEvidence.note: flow-stability smoke covers dirty-worktree production helper passing projectRoot and custom storyDir metadata staying koala_metadata_changes
semantic scope guard smoke covers review-scope-binding excluding custom storyDir metadata while preserving clean binding freshness
negative controls prove workflow/notes.md and real material/fixture paths are not hidden by custom storyDir metadata exclusions

items.title: Run lifecycle validation and record evidence
items.context: Run build, targeted regression tests, process-fact contract, koala validate/session_brief checks, and record transcript/evidence for the story.
items.userSees: 最终 transcript 会显示："Build PASS; freshness smoke PASS; process fact contract PASS; koala validate PASS; no self-churn stale advisory."

happy.desc: Build, targeted stale-loop regression, and process-fact/lifecycle validation pass.

edge.desc: session_brief output is explicitly checked for absence of self-churn stale advisory after validate/test-evidence update.

adversarial.desc: DONE-related gates still fail on missing delivery/summary or real drift until normal lifecycle evidence is supplied.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/semantic-scope-guard-smoke.js && npm --prefix packages/main run test:verification-freshness-smoke && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Codex ran build plus flow-stability, semantic-scope, verification-freshness, and process-fact checks after the custom storyDir follow-up
transcript-diff records TEST session_brief actual output: evidence freshness matched current HEAD and no self-churn EVIDENCE STALE advisory appeared
negative controls verify unrelated material drift remains stale while metadata self-churn stays fresh
